bio: Martha founded Bloom & Burr as a weekend pop-up and still roasts most of its coffee.
Iris brings food science to the cupping table and hosts the monthly Cupping Day.
Nora runs Forward Coffee, the bicycle espresso cart, and serves at every Brew Camp.
Rose turns the questions from the Thursday clinic into lessons for beginners.
Leah roasts, teaches the roasting basics and leads the blind cuppings.
Daniel teaches espresso and latte art; his clinics are where most first hearts are poured.
Peter hosts the Home Brewers' Forum and plans the outdoor events.
